# Surfpool - From Localnet to Mainnet

> Drop-in replacement for solana-test-validator. Simulate programs locally using Mainnet accounts.

Surfpool is purpose-built to offer the best possible experience for developers building on Solana. It provides a local Solana network simulator (Surfnet) that can fork Mainnet state, along with Infrastructure as Code tooling for deployments.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install CLI
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.surfpool.run | sh

# Start local network
surfpool
```

Dashboard: http://localhost:8488

## Key Features

- **Mainnet Forking**: Clone accounts, programs, and token balances from Mainnet
- **Cheatcodes**: Powerful testing utilities for state manipulation
- **Infrastructure as Code**: Define deployments using txtx DSL
- **Terminal UI**: Real-time visibility into your local network
- **Full RPC Compatibility**: Drop-in replacement for solana-test-validator

## CLI Commands

```bash
surfpool                    # Start Surfnet with TUI dashboard
surfpool --no-tui           # Start without TUI
surfpool --rpc-port 8899    # Custom RPC port
surfpool --help             # Show all options
```

## Surfnet Configuration (Surfpool.toml)

```toml
[network]
rpc_port = 8899
ws_port = 8900

[accounts]
# Clone accounts from mainnet
clone = [
  "TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA",
  "ATokenGPvbdGVxr1b2hvZbsiqW5xWH25efTNsLJA8knL"
]

[programs]
# Clone programs with their data
clone = [
  "metaqbxxUerdq28cj1RbAWkYQm3ybzjb6a8bt518x1s"
]
```

## Cheatcodes (Surfnet-specific RPC methods)

Surfpool provides special RPC methods for testing:

### Account Manipulation
```bash
# Set account data
curl -X POST http://localhost:8899 -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "surfnet_setAccount",
  "params": {
    "pubkey": "...",
    "lamports": 1000000000,
    "data": "...",
    "owner": "...",
    "executable": false
  }
}'

# Set token account balance
curl -X POST http://localhost:8899 -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "surfnet_setTokenAccount",
  "params": {
    "pubkey": "...",
    "mint": "...",
    "owner": "...",
    "amount": 1000000
  }
}'

# Clone program from mainnet
curl -X POST http://localhost:8899 -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "surfnet_cloneProgramAccount",
  "params": {
    "pubkey": "..."
  }
}'
```

### Time Manipulation
```bash
# Advance clock
surfnet_advanceClock

# Time travel to specific slot/timestamp
surfnet_timeTravel

# Pause/resume clock
surfnet_pauseClock
surfnet_resumeClock
```

### Transaction Profiling
```bash
# Profile transaction compute units
surfnet_profileTransaction

# Get profiling results
surfnet_getProfileResults
```

### Network Control
```bash
# Reset network state
surfnet_resetNetwork

# Export snapshot
surfnet_exportSnapshot

# Get surfnet info
surfnet_getSurfnetInfo
```

## Infrastructure as Code (txtx DSL)

Define deployments using the txtx DSL in `.tx` files:

### Basic Runbook Structure

```hcl
// deployment.tx
addon "svm" {
  network = "devnet"
}

signer "deployer" "svm::secret_key" {
  secret_key = input.deployer_secret_key
}

action "deploy_program" "svm::deploy_program" {
  program_path = "./target/deploy/my_program.so"
  signer = signer.deployer
}

output "program_id" {
  value = action.deploy_program.program_id
}
```

### Available SVM Actions

- `svm::deploy_program` - Deploy a program
- `svm::send_transaction` - Send a transaction
- `svm::call_program` - Call a program instruction
- `svm::create_account` - Create a new account
- `svm::transfer` - Transfer SOL

### Available SVM Functions

- `svm::get_account_info` - Get account information
- `svm::get_balance` - Get SOL balance
- `svm::pubkey` - Create a pubkey from string
- `svm::keypair` - Generate a new keypair

## Standard Library Functions

### Hash Functions
```hcl
sha256(value)      # SHA-256 hash
keccak256(value)   # Keccak-256 hash
ripemd160(value)   # RIPEMD-160 hash
```

### Encoding Functions
```hcl
encode_hex(value)      # Encode to hex
base64_decode(value)   # Decode base64
```

### Utility Functions
```hcl
index(list, i)     # Get list element at index
jq(json, query)    # JQ query on JSON
```

### Assertions
```hcl
assert_eq(left, right)   # Assert equality
assert_ne(left, right)   # Assert inequality
assert_gt(left, right)   # Assert greater than
assert_gte(left, right)  # Assert greater or equal
assert_lt(left, right)   # Assert less than
assert_lte(left, right)  # Assert less or equal
```

## RPC Endpoints

Surfpool supports all standard Solana RPC methods plus Surfnet cheatcodes:

### Standard Methods
- `getAccountInfo`, `getBalance`, `getMultipleAccounts`
- `getBlock`, `getBlockHeight`, `getSlot`
- `getTransaction`, `sendTransaction`, `simulateTransaction`
- `getLatestBlockhash`, `getSignatureStatuses`
- Full list at: https://docs.surfpool.io/rpc/overview

### Cheatcode Methods (surfnet_*)
- `surfnet_setAccount`, `surfnet_setTokenAccount`
- `surfnet_cloneProgramAccount`, `surfnet_setProgramAuthority`
- `surfnet_timeTravel`, `surfnet_advanceClock`
- `surfnet_profileTransaction`, `surfnet_getProfileResults`
- `surfnet_resetNetwork`, `surfnet_exportSnapshot`
- Full list at: https://docs.surfpool.io/rpc/cheatcodes

## WebSocket Subscriptions

```javascript
// Account subscription
ws.send(JSON.stringify({
  jsonrpc: "2.0",
  id: 1,
  method: "accountSubscribe",
  params: ["pubkey...", { encoding: "base64" }]
}));

// Program subscription
ws.send(JSON.stringify({
  jsonrpc: "2.0",
  id: 1,
  method: "programSubscribe",
  params: ["programId...", { encoding: "base64" }]
}));

// Slot subscription
ws.send(JSON.stringify({
  jsonrpc: "2.0",
  id: 1,
  method: "slotSubscribe"
}));
```
